stem.x: Both Data mining and Process mining are methods for improving business operations. While Data mining aims to discover knowledge by analyzing large amounts of data by using statistical and AI analysis methods, which of the following is an appropriate explanation of Process mining?

b.x: It is a management strategy focused on changing workflows and business processes within an organization by emphasizing new ideas and new ways of doing business.
It is a method aimed at analyzing data sets, finding unsuspected relationships, and summarizing the data in novel ways.
It is a methodology for improving performance by systematically removing unnecessary data.
It is a technique for analyzing and improving business processes by using knowledge that is extracted from event logs.
